reset.title: Danger zone: global data reset
reset.description: Only the owner can erase business and VPN data for a fresh launch. This is separate from selective deletion and affects the whole platform, not the current filter.
reset.preservedSummary: OWNER, ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN login accounts, infrastructure, audit history, the quota ledger and project files are preserved.
reset.reopen: View or resume the same reset
reset.recoveryReceipt: Original purge receipt: maintenance recovery still required
reset.recoveryDescription: Operation {{id}} was interrupted. Explicit recovery uses its original nonce to retrieve its receipt or restore maintenance. It never starts another data purge. No new preview will be loaded until recovery is resolved.
reset.recoveryAcknowledgment: I authorize recovery of the original operation and maintenance restoration, without starting a new data purge.
reset.historicalHint: This receipt describes a previous operation, not the current inventory. No new reset was performed by opening this screen.
reset.productionScope: Production mode: all resellers, support and client accounts, VPN licences, devices, activations, plans, configurations and traffic are in scope.
reset.usersScope: Users counts only non-administrative login accounts. VPN licences and associated data are deleted even when their holder is an administrator; the administrator's login account is kept.
reset.projectFilesPreserved: No project file, code, deployment key or APK is deleted. Server infrastructure remains in place.
reset.backupRequired: A private automatic backup is mandatory before deletion. The owner must reauthenticate. The service enters temporary maintenance and the deletion is transactional.
reset.lockException: This exceptional global OWNER operation also erases password-protected configurations after reauthentication and backup. It does not reveal their secrets or unlock their selective editing or deletion.
reset.acknowledgment: I understand that this deletes live business and VPN data across the whole platform, including protected configurations, and that recovery requires the private backup.
reset.pending: Operation in progress. Do not close or reload this page.
reset.sameChallenge: The previous request may already have taken effect. Retry only this same operation: its original confirmation nonce is retained in memory and replay cannot erase newly created data. No new preview is loaded automatically. Do not reload the browser.
reset.readback: Current inventory reread from the server
reset.readbackFailed: The reset is confirmed, but the current inventory could not be reread. Do not run another reset to refresh this view.

warnings.lockedConfigs: Protected configurations are included only in this global reset exception.
warnings.adminVpnData: Administrators keep their login accounts, not their VPN licences, activations or plans.
warnings.privateBackup: The backup is private and server-side; no backup path or secret is displayed here.
warnings.storage: Deleted database space may be reused. No immediate disk-space or GB reduction is promised.

bulkDelete.profileHint: Selective profile deletion always requires each profile's current unlock grant, even for the owner. Linked plans or engine conflicts block deletion; there is no automatic cascade and device activation is not disabled.

bulkDelete.accountHint: OWNER, ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN login accounts, and your own account, are never selected or deleted by this operation. Reseller and support accounts must be chosen explicitly; no automatic cleanup runs.
bulkDelete.subscriptionHint: Delete these data plans, separately from adding data or extending validity. Device activation stays intact. Resellers can select only their own clients' plans.
bulkDelete.profilePage: {{count}} filtered profiles. At most {{limit}} profile cards are displayed per page.

presence.honestyTitle: What this tracking measures, and what it does not
presence.honestyExplanation: A device is listed because it recently reported its tunnel up. Missing signal proves no disconnection: the network may be down, the battery flat, or the app closed by the system. Nothing is therefore ever shown as disconnected, only as last observed activity. No traffic, no destination and no content is observed.
